123101.effect: At the start of battle, spawns 1 Level 1 Vortex Mirage behind itself. The Mirage has 1 HP and 30% of a standard Vortex's ATK.

180931.name: Mobile Power Station
180931.effect: Increases Vortex's range by 10. Increases ATK of ground friendly units within 100m by 30% (Does not stack).

493101.name: Accumulator Shield
493101.effect: Accumulates energy while attacking. Every 5 attacks, deploys a shield with a radius of 40 at the current location , and increases the required attacks for the next shield by 5. The shield has a base HP of 2000, increasing by an additional 2000 HP per Vortex level.

503101.name: Emergency Armor
503101.effect: When HP first falls below 50%, activates Emergency Armor, resisting all damage and becoming untargetable for 4 seconds. Emergency Armor will not activate if HP reaches 0.

1232.name: Summon Hounds
1232.effect: At the start of battle, summons 2 Hounds of the same level as the Centurion.

5132.name: Reactive Armor
5132.effect: Reduces incoming damage by 80%, up to 5 times.

5532.name: Melee Mode
5532.effect: Equips powerful melee weaponry, but cannot carry spare ammo. The rifle magazine holds 20 rounds. Upon ammo depletion, the Centurion switches to melee mode and charges at the enemy: Movement Speed increases by 18, HP increase by 300%,  ATK increases by 300%, Attack Interval increases by 0.8 seconds, and attacks deal 9m Splash Damage.

110321.name: Dual Wield
110321.effect: The Centurion wields a rifle in each hand, capable of attacking two enemies simultaneously, but range decreases by 25.

110322.name: Homing Missile
110322.effect: Fires 2 tracking missiles at distant enemies every 5s. Max range is 160m, min range is 45m. Each deals 2000 damage with an explosion radius of 5m.

72002.name: Saturation Bombardment
72002.effect: Increases splash range by 3, and each attack fires 16 shells in succession, and shells spread out over a wide area, but increases attack interval by 120%.

302002.name: Mountain Plating
302002.effect: Blocks 700 damage when attacked. The damage blocking effect increases with the Rank. And for each Rank, blocks an additional 700 damage.

312002.name: Anti-Aircraft Ammunition
312002.effect: Decreases ATK by 40%, allowing Mountain to attack aerial targets.

1032002.name: Extended Range Ammo
1032002.effect: Increases range by 160, but decreases ATK by 75%.

11020021.name: Gun-launched Missile
11020021.effect: Launches a rocket from its arm cannons every 14 seconds. The rocket has a range of 180, causing 22500 damage to enemies within a 15m radius of the hit point. Damage increases by 22500 per unit Rank increased.

11020022.name: Smoke Bomb
11020022.effect: Launches 8 Smoke Bombs towards the enemy every 25s. The Smoke Bombs have a max range of 180m and a minimum range of 60m. The range of units within the smoke is reduced by 35%.

18032002.name: Photon Loop
18032002.effect: Every 30s, covers the unit with a photon coating, decreasing damage received by 30% within 25s and grants immunity to Electromagnetic, Ignited, Acid, and Degeneration Beam effects
